name: Chat-Audio Attacks (CAA)
description: CAA is a benchmark designed to evaluate the robustness of large language models with voice interaction capabilities against four distinct types of adversarial audio attacks in conversational scenarios. It includes three evaluation strategies: standard metrics, GPT-4o-based simulation, and human evaluation.
reputation: A recent security benchmark from the literature with limited public adoption so far, mainly used to study audio-based adversarial robustness in voice-enabled LLM systems.
notes: Focuses on adversarial audio attacks in conversational LLMs; evaluates with multiple strategies including human evaluation.
